_comment: MSFS proof-honesty baseline (schema v3, 2026-07-10). Matches the live `verum audit --proof-honesty` classifier, which emits a COMBINED theorem_axiom_only counter (audit schema_version 1). The v2 structural/tautological split relied on a classifier the current CLI does not implement; its enforcement did not disappear — the forbidden classes (axiom `ensures true`, theorems discharged solely by such axioms, theorems with `ensures true`) are now checked textually by tests/integration/proof_honesty_gate.sh itself, corpus-side, independent of CLI classifier churn.
_baseline_iteration: post-wiring baseline: corpus GREEN under verum check (17 modules), Intensional Grading block included

totals_min._invariant: running totals must satisfy: total[k] >= totals_min[k] for monotone metrics, total[k] <= totals_max[k] for the trivial counters.
